title: Bella & Duke Sign-Up Journey
description: Led the development of a complete sign-up journey for Bella & Duke, a premium raw dog food company. Key features include: multi-step onboarding flow with dynamic form validation, interactive Vue 2 prototypes for stakeholder demos, custom meal plan builder with real-time pricing calculations, and seamless integration with existing backend systems. When requirements shifted, successfully re-architected the solution using vanilla JavaScript to optimize performance and reduce bundle size while maintaining all functionality.

title: Zywave Texting Application
description: Built enterprise-grade texting platform from the ground up enabling insurance agents to communicate with customers via SMS/MMS. Key features include: real-time bi-directional messaging with Twilio integration, bulk SMS campaigns with scheduling and templating, contact management with smart search and filtering, admin dashboard with interactive charts (Chart.js) showing message analytics and usage metrics, comprehensive user onboarding flow, and mobile-responsive design. Architected state management with Pinia, conducted client demos, mentored 3 junior developers, and collaborated with UX team to optimize user workflows.

title: Valais Tourism & Hospitality
description: Led frontend development for Valais tourism platform serving thousands of daily visitors. Key achievements include: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance with semantic HTML and ARIA labels, multilingual support (i18n) for 4 languages, headless CMS integration (Contentful) with GraphQL for dynamic content management, custom D3.js weather data visualizations with interactive charts, Algolia-powered search with filters and faceting, server-side rendering (SSR) optimization for SEO, comprehensive TypeScript type safety across 50+ components, and responsive design implementation from Figma mockups. Conducted thorough code reviews maintaining 95%+ code quality scores.

title: Fraser Yachts
description: Brought in as Key Engineer to rescue Fraser Yachts luxury platform and meet critical launch deadlines. Major accomplishments include: complete refactoring of Algolia search implementation with advanced filtering and faceting for 1000+ yacht listings, navigation system overhaul improving UX and performance, migration of Swiper components through 2 major versions with zero downtime, sophisticated yacht comparison tool with side-by-side specifications, Kontent.AI headless CMS integration for content management, and TypeScript migration improving code reliability. Delivered features 2 weeks ahead of schedule while maintaining 100% test coverage on critical paths. Active participant in Agile ceremonies, client presentations, and mentoring team on best practices.

title: Contentful CMS Custom Apps
description: Led development and maintenance of Lonely Planet's enterprise content management platform as Key Engineer for Red Ventures. Key responsibilities include: architecting custom Contentful editor applications serving 100+ content creators, managing 5+ interconnected repositories with CI/CD pipelines, implementing custom field extensions and UI widgets for enhanced content workflows, building reusable React component library for editor apps, TypeScript-first approach ensuring type safety across all integrations, API optimization reducing content loading times by 40%, comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials for new team members, and establishing code quality standards with ESLint/Prettier configurations. Successfully delivered 15+ feature enhancements while maintaining zero downtime.

title: Team Organiser
description: Full-stack football team management application showcasing modern web development practices. Key features include: intelligent team balancing algorithm that analyzes player ratings and generates optimal fair matchups, comprehensive player management with skill ratings and statistics tracking, secure JWT authentication with role-based access control, GraphQL API with Apollo Server for efficient data fetching, type-safe database layer with Prisma ORM, responsive Vue 3 frontend with Composition API, real-time updates and optimistic UI patterns, and complete TypeScript implementation across frontend and backend ensuring type safety. Built as a personal project to solve real-world team organization challenges while demonstrating full-stack capabilities.
